newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: IMPORT PRESSURE PUSHES ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LOWER.
newsitem.headline: IMPORT PRESSURE PUSHES ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LOWER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against hard currencies on the back of import pressure, dealers said.
"There was a payment of nearly $1 million today and the local dollar moved quite a bit," one dealer said.
"We're expecting another big payment next week so the dollar should keep on going down," he added.
At Thursday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.1825/1925 against the U.S. dollar, a two-cent loss over its 11.1625/1725 levels on Wednesday.
Against sterling it also finished weaker at 17.9000/9300 compared to 17.7540/7790 and was at 6.6000/6200 versus the mark, down from 6.5415/5490.
The local currency ended the day at 2.5400/5600 against the rand from 2.5300/5400.
